name: Potato cultivation in Punjab (district area, production, yield)
dataset: Table 'Area and Production of Potato Crop in major potato growing districts of Punjab' (latest published year; the page cites the Department of Horticulture, Punjab) plus the page's short statements on major districts and varieties
geography: Punjab, India: district and state level
frequency: Annual (whenever PAU updates the page); checked weekly
units: Area: hectares; production: metric tonnes; yield: quintals per hectare
licence: Not stated on the page. Only factual figures and short attributed excerpts are stored; always shown with source and year.
usageNotes: The URL originally given for this resource, web3.pau.edu/potato/Potato_cult.php, no longer resolves (DNS). The same page is served at www.pau.edu/potato/. The figures are the Punjab Department of Horticulture's, republished by PAU; they are not SeedChain observations.
integrationNote: Verified live on 2026-10-07: HTTP 200; HTML table parsed and cross-checked (yield = production / area).
